A LITTLE PLANNING. A WARMER WELCOME.

Your next visit,
made easier.

Choose a preferred date and time, leave your contact details and let us know what brings you in.

  1. 01
    Choose your preferred visit

    Select a date and a 30-minute slot within our listed opening hours.

  2. 02
    Wait for the team's decision

    Requests start as Pending. Check Visit history to see whether your visit is Accepted or Denied.

  3. 03
    Keep your history access code

    We provide a private code with your first request. Use it with your phone number to view your visits on another device.
